<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 180.042, which in positive‑mode ESI likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. The isotopic pattern shows an M+1 peak at ~10 % of the base, consistent with about nine carbon atoms (9 × 1.1 % ≈ 10 %). A formula containing nine carbons that matches the mass is C₉H₉NO₃ (exact mass 179.058 Da, within experimental error). This formula also fits the observed isotopic intensity (13C contribution ≈ 10 %). Therefore the molecular formula is C9H9NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H9NO3</final_answer>
